continuity: Jin Taekyung remains committed to the Peace Guild alongside Team Leader Choi, Butler Kim, Song Song, and Im Kkeokjeong despite the Guild’s conflict with Ares Guild.
The Peace Guild continues to possess more than twenty Gate monopolies, real estate, and enormous negotiated compensation from Lee Jungryong’s side.
The Peace Guild continues recruiting and training Hunters through selective intake, generous allowances, and exclusive Gate rights.
Taekyung continues personally leading harsh accelerated training raids for Peace Guild recruits, using monster luring and formation drills.
Kim Jinsoo remains the informal leader and operational right hand of the third-week trainees during raids.
The A-rank Gate Black Wizard’s Black Forest is ruled by a black wizard or necromancer and contains powerful undead monsters.
The leading Skeleton Knight has evolved into a speaking Level 105 Skeleton Warlord, the new master of the Black Forest and commander of its undead.
The Skeleton Warlord claims it can gather more than a thousand subordinate undead by searching the Black Forest, but no working arrangement with Taekyung has yet been established.

Taekyung used One Annihilation in a confined path to destroy hundreds of the Warlord’s Skeleton army, received one level-up, and had Exhaustion and all other status abnormalities removed by the System.
The Skeleton Warlord survived the attack as a damaged skull and is now negotiating with Taekyung after Taekyung proposed working together.
Taekyung completed this raid without any trainee deaths; he had previously ordered all fifty Peace Guild members out of the Gate and stayed behind alone.
Team Leader Choi and three other senior Guild members remain focused on training the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique rather than joining this raid.
plot: The leading Skeleton Knight evolves into a Level 105 Skeleton Warlord after defeating the Black Forest’s previous ruler, becoming the forest’s new master and commander of its undead. Once an outstanding human knight, the Warlord has lost all memories of its former life and now seeks to expand its territory by raising ever-larger undead armies.

Jin Taekyung lures the Skeleton Warlord and hundreds of Skeletons into a narrow path before unleashing One Annihilation. The blue-flame attack destroys hundreds of undead, leaves Taekyung Exhausted, and triggers a level-up that restores all status abnormalities. He then finishes off the surviving Skeletons and discovers that the Warlord’s damaged skull is still alive.

The Warlord reveals that it can speak, attempts to bargain by offering the Black Forest, and claims it can gather more than a thousand subordinates to find whatever Taekyung wants. Taekyung rejects the forest as compensation, considers destroying the Warlord for its skull, then proposes working together after realizing that the Warlord’s command over the undead could be useful. The Warlord’s skull trembles at Taekyung’s sinister smile.

active_continuity: The Peace Guild remains committed to its members and continues expanding through selective Hunter recruitment, generous support, and exclusive Gate rights.
Taekyung leads accelerated training raids for Peace Guild recruits, with Kim Jinsoo acting as the third-week trainees’ operational deputy.
The A-rank Black Wizard’s Black Forest contains a large undead army and was ruled by a black wizard or necromancer.
The leading Skeleton Knight evolved into a speaking Level 105 Skeleton Warlord, a former human knight who lost its memories and became the Black Forest’s new ruler.
The Skeleton Warlord commands the undead and claims it can gather more than a thousand subordinates by searching the Black Forest.
Taekyung used One Annihilation against the Warlord’s tightly packed army, destroyed hundreds of Skeletons, gained a level, and recovered from Exhaustion through the System.
The Skeleton Warlord survived as a damaged skull and began bargaining with Taekyung by offering the Black Forest and its subordinate undead.
Taekyung proposed working together with the Skeleton Warlord, but the arrangement has not yet been completed.
Taekyung has completed repeated training raids without trainee deaths so far, though injuries have occurred.
Team Leader Choi and three other senior Guild members remain focused on cultivating the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique.
open_questions: Who actually taught Jin Taekyung the Jin Family’s Cultivation Technique?
What history led Lee Jungryong to regard the unrelated Cheon Taemin as his older brother?
How extensive are Ares Guild’s undisclosed forces beyond its officially registered Hunters?
Will Im Kkeokjeong’s reattached arms and trauma recover sufficiently for him to return to Hunter work?
What is the origin of the large qi mass in Team Leader Choi’s dantian?
What prevented Taekyung from completing his breakthrough into the Supreme Peak realm?
What caused the Skeleton Warlord’s unusual evolution, and what will result from Taekyung’s proposed cooperation with it?

Poem associated with Jeong Mong-ju and unwavering loyalty.
System function that lets Taekyung understand demon-world speech.

profile_creations.personality: Dominating, ambitious, contemptuous of humans, and eager to expand its territory; opportunistic and quick to panic when faced with destruction.
profile_creations.relationships: Commands the Skeletons and other undead in the Black Forest. Initially wants to turn Jin Taekyung into a subordinate, then offers the forest and its forces during a desperate negotiation; Taekyung proposes working together, but no agreement is completed.
profile_creations.role: A former outstanding human knight who lost all memories after becoming a monster; evolved from the leading Skeleton Knight into a Level 105 Skeleton Warlord and became the new ruler of the Black Forest and commander of its undead.
profile_creations.voice: Initially halting and syllable-separated, with smoother and more deferential speech when bargaining for survival.
